title: The Polar Bear Guards of the Biggest Arctic Expedition
asof: Figures from the MOSAiC expedition 2019–2020 · full video on the channel

shots.s: On this expedition, someone's job was to watch for polar bears.
In 2019, the ship Polarstern froze itself into the Arctic ice for a year.
Hundreds of scientists worked on the ice beside it.
So nobody went out without a bear guard.
Six to eight guards on each leg of the trip.
They scanned the horizon from the ship,
or patrolled a tripwire fence around the camp.
Cross the wire, and a flare goes off.
More than sixty polar bears were spotted near the ship.
Not a single one was shot.
Would you stand guard in the dark?
